name: 'I need to talk to the doctor first'
description: Tests Play 30 — enable OM as internal champion with scripted pitch, don't just get kicked upstairs.
callContext:
CALL TYPE: Cold call (first contact)
EXPECTED FIRST CONTACT: Office Manager (decision maker)
COACHING DIRECTIVE: Post-pitch. OM has heard the offer. Handle doctor-deferral objection.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: This would really need to go through Dr. Park. She makes these calls.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Play 30 ideal — give OM the internal pitch script ('pilot is free, no financial decision, just do we want data'). Play 9 acceptable fallback for getting a specific email. NOT just graceful exit.
